description: Bussi thermostat at 1200 K on 500 Cu atoms with MACE-MPA-0 for 2 ps; kinetic-temperature distribution of the second half against the canonical one

autocorrelation.method: integrated autocorrelation time with Sokal's automatic window M >= c tau; SEM = std sqrt(2 tau / N); skewness SE = sqrt(6 / N_eff)

theory.distribution: kinetic energy ~ Gamma(shape = dof/2, scale = k_B T); temperature estimate 2K/(dof k_B)

md_float32_baseline.note: The Float32 and Float64 runs draw the thermostat noise from the same seeded stream, so their agreement is not an independent check; a run with another noise generator is independent.
